title: Unlocking the Codex harness: how we built the App Server
summary: Learn how to embed the Codex agent using the Codex App Server, a bidirectional JSON-RPC API powering streaming progress, tool use, approvals, and diffs.
body: Learn how to embed the Codex agent using the Codex App Server, a bidirectional JSON-RPC API powering streaming progress, tool use, approvals, and diffs.
summaryZh: OpenAI公开了Codex harness的技术细节，重点介绍了如何通过Codex App Server来嵌入Codex Agent。该服务器提供了一个基于双向JSON-RPC的API接口，支持流式进度反馈、工具调用、人工审批和差异比对（diffs）等高级功能。
